events.say: Ugh, nearly lost my passport again... shoved it in the top desk drawer so I actually know where it is for once.
Morning Aria... man I need caffeine. Just so you know, for coffee I'm strictly oat milk, no sugar, forever and always.
My older sister Maya called earlier, talked my ear off for like forty minutes.
Maya keeps complaining about the rain... I mean, that's what happens when you're living in Seattle, right?
Ugh, booked the dentist. February 14 at 2pm. Super romantic Valentine's plans for me lol.
Great, just great, the check engine light is on in the car again. Love that for my wallet.
I swear half the street drives the exact same dark blue hatchback as my car, I almost tried to unlock the wrong one today.
Hid the spare key under the blue flowerpot on the porch... super original hiding spot, I know.
Too cold to walk to the gym, honestly. I put my gym membership as frozen for the winter.
When the gym membership is running it's $45 a month, which isn't terrible if I actually go.
Oh wait Aria, dentist receptionist called—moved my dentist appointment to February 21 at 10am instead.
My laptop is basically a desktop now because the battery dies in an hour if I unplug it.
Still really like this laptop though, the 13-inch silver pro fits in literally any backpack.
My younger brother Leo is coming by this weekend to borrow some tools, pray for my sanity.
Gotta remember if I make tacos for brother Leo that he hates cilantro, got that soap gene thing.
Looking at new running shoes online... I'm always a size 9.5 in trainers.
Tossed my muddy running shoes in the bottom of the hall closet, out of sight out of mind.
Wanted to do my tax return tonight but ugh, still missing one form from the bank.
At least the tax return isn't due till April 15, got a little breathing room.
Tried making a smoothie and the blender started leaking from the bottom... smoothie all over the counter.
Set up a vet appointment for Milo—March 30 at 4pm. Don't let me forget to get the carrier out early.
Cat Milo is such a diva, bought three kinds of wet food and he only eats salmon pate.
Weighed cat Milo by holding him on the scale—he's a solid 11 pounds of fluff.
Finally warm enough to pack away the winter coat! Stuffed it in the vacuum bag under the bed.
Honestly that olive green parka is the best winter coat I've ever owned.
Boom! Tax return is officially filed and accepted. Done with paperwork for a year.
My camping tent is lent to Sam for his trip up north, hope he doesn't lose the stakes.
That camping tent is a three-person dome tent, super easy to pitch.
Picked up my acoustic guitar to noodle around and ping—the high e string is snapped.
Left the acoustic guitar leaning behind the sofa for now.
Checked out a massive biography today, library book is due May 12.
Put the library book on the nightstand so I actually read a chapter before bed.
When it comes to olive oil I'm such a snob now, gotta be cold-pressed Greek.
Stepped on the bathroom scale and nothing happened, thing is totally out of batteries.
Got a text from cousin Tariq—he's my mom's nephew on the other side of the family.
Looks like cousin Tariq is visiting in July for a few days, gonna be fun.
Unfroze my gym membership today, so it's active again. No more excuses.
This black mesh ergonomic desk chair was worth every penny for my back.
Well I jinxed the desk chair, now the left armrest is wobbly. Need an Allen wrench.
Left my sunglasses in the car glovebox so I have them for highway driving.
Those sunglasses are polarized tortoiseshell, took me ages to find frames that fit my face.
My poor sourdough starter is hiding in the back of the fridge.
Checked the sourdough starter and yeah, it's dormant, needs feeding before I can bake.
Decided the desk wasn't secure enough, moved my passport so now it's in the fireproof safe.
Wanted to hem my pants but remembered my sewing machine is at my aunt's house.
Booked the flight to Chicago! August 8 at 7am, brutal wakeup call.
At least for the flight to Chicago I snagged a window seat, always my pick.
Trying to keep the grocery budget strictly at $400 a month this summer.
Got soaked on the trail today, the waterproofing wore off on my hiking boots.
Put the hiking boots on the mudroom rack to dry out.
Bumped into neighbor Dave in the hall—you know, the guy in apartment 4B.
Neighbor Dave mentioned he loves sourdough bread, I should bake him a loaf sometime.
Picked up the car from the shop! It's freshly serviced and running fine now, thank goodness.
Uh oh, the dishwasher started making a grinding noise mid-cycle.
Left my yoga mat rolled up by the balcony door so I can stretch in the morning sun.
events.value: rolled up by the balcony door

events.say: Love that my yoga mat is extra thick purple foam, saves my knees.
Caved and bought reading glasses... plus 1.5 strength. Officially getting old lol.
Dropped my reading glasses on the kitchen counter next to the fruit bowl.
Finally showed the acoustic guitar some love—it's restrung and tuned.
That plant in hallway is a fiddle leaf fig and somehow I haven't killed it yet.
Roots are poking out of the plant in hallway, def need to repot into a bigger planter soon.
Popped open the air conditioner panel and oof, the filter is super dusty.
If we're talking pizza, thin crust with mushrooms and olives is undefeated.
events.value: thin crust with mushrooms and olives

events.say: Airline changed my schedule, so my flight to Chicago is August 9 at 6pm now.
Had a 1-on-1 with boss Elena today—she's head of product over at work.
One thing about boss Elena, she prefers Slack over email for literally everything.
Went to go for a ride and saw my bicycle back tire is flat. Bummer.
Kept the bicycle locked in the basement storage so it's out of the rain.
Took the spare key from the porch, it's with neighbor Dave now in case I lock myself out.
Stuck the umbrella in the coat stand by the entry.
Can't miss my umbrella in a crowd, it's bright yellow with wooden handle.
Whenever I put a podcast on while cleaning, it's always true crime and history stuff.
Staring at the bedroom walls... I really wanna paint them sage green before winter.
Half my bagel is raw because on the toaster the left slot doesn't heat up anymore.
Sam finally returned my camping tent! It's back in the garage.
Our big anniversary dinner with the friend group is set for November 5 at 8pm.
For the anniversary dinner I still need to book the Italian place downtown.
Found my earbuds! They were in my left jacket pocket the whole time.
Pitcher water filter is blinking red, needs replacement.
Perfumed soap makes me sneeze, so for laundry detergent I only buy unscented liquid.
Doctor told me to cut the caffeine and dairy-heavy stuff, so my coffee preference is black decaf only now.
Got my laptop back from the repair bar—new battery installed, works great!
Food prices are wild, bumped my grocery budget up to $450 a month.
Brought my sunglasses inside from the car, they're sitting on the entry table.
Fixed up the water filter pitcher—fresh cartridge installed.
Freezing out there today! Pulled the winter coat out, it's hanging by the front door now.
Fixed the bicycle! New tube put in, ready to ride.
events.value: new tube put in, ready to ride

events.say: Moved my reading glasses so they're in the nightstand drawer for bedtime reading.
Big news—sister Maya packed up and moved to Portland this week!
Ugh, my earbuds are acting up, the right side stopped charging.

chatter.say: Happy New Year Aria! Man, I stayed up way too late watching fireworks on TV.
Why is it already dark at 4:30pm... winter is such a scam.
Burnt my toast a little bit,eh, just gonna scrape it over the sink.
Have you seen the wind out there today? The trees are sideways.
Binge-watched four episodes of that cooking show, now I'm starving for no reason.
Honestly just in a weird sleepy mood all afternoon.
Ooh, it's snowing! Big fluffy flakes too.
That movie ending made zero sense, who wrote that script??
Thinking about making grilled cheese and tomato soup tonight. Classic.
Ugh, Monday brain is hitting hard today, can't focus on anything.
The sun actually came out for ten whole minutes, miracle of miracles.
Accidentally put salt instead of sugar in my oatmeal... do not recommend.
Why are reality TV shows so addictive when nothing even happens?
Slush everywhere on the sidewalks, my socks got damp just walking to the corner.
Feeling super energized today for once, might actually clean the kitchen.
Smells like someone down the hall is frying garlic, making me so hungry.
Spring rain is nice when you're inside under a blanket.
Stayed up watching a documentary about deep sea squids. Weirdly calming.
Nothing beats fresh strawberries when they're actually sweet.
Pollen count must be crazy today, everyone outside is sneezing.
TGIF Aria, seriously thought this week would never end.
Tried a new ramen recipe and ngl, I kind of nailed the broth.
That cliffhanger on last night's episode should be illegal.
Perfect 70-degree breeze coming through the window right now.
Just having one of those lazy Sundays where I don't wanna move off the couch.
Cut open an avocado and it was 100% perfect, I should buy a lottery ticket.
Thunderstorm rolling in! Love the sound of distant thunder.
Rewatching old sitcoms is basically my comfort blanket.
So humid out today, feels like walking through warm soup.
Ate way too many tortilla chips before dinner, ruined my appetite lol.
Why do commercials always seem twice as loud as the actual show?
Cicadas are buzzing like crazy outside this afternoon.
Cold watermelon on a hot day hits different.
In such a good mood today, everything at work actually went smoothly.
Watched a sci-fi flick last night, special effects were surprisingly decent.
Heatwave is no joke, the pavement looks like it's melting.
Made iced tea and forgot to put ice in it... so, lukewarm tea I guess.
Yawning every five seconds, def didn't sleep deep enough.
There's a double rainbow out the back window right now!
Popcorn for dinner counts as a balanced meal if you're tired enough, right?
Nothing good on TV tonight, just scrolling through menus for twenty minutes.
You can totally feel autumn in the air this morning, nice and crisp.
Roasted some butternut squash, whole place smells amazing.
Feeling a bit restless tonight, might do a puzzle or something.
Leaves are starting to turn orange down the block, looks awesome.
Started a new mystery series on streaming, already hooked.
Drizzling all day, classic gray October vibes.
Apple cider donuts are dangerous, I ate three without blinking.
Spooky movie marathon tonight! Well, mildly spooky, I'm a wimp.
Frost on the rooftops this morning, brrr.
Made a huge pot of chili, gonna be eating leftovers for days.
Daylight saving time ending always messes with my internal clock.
That game show host has way too much energy for 7pm.
Wind is howling against the windows tonight, glad I'm indoors.
Cinnamon rolls fresh out of the oven... peak happiness.
Just feeling super cozy and grateful today, honestly.
Cheesy holiday movies are terrible and yet I watch them every single year.
Sky has that flat white look like it's about to dump snow.
Hot cocoa with way too many marshmallows is the move tonight.
Can't believe another year flew by like that, wild.
